corrected_code:
from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException, status
from fastapi.responses import StreamingResponse
import clickhouse_connect
import io

router = APIRouter(prefix="/audit/clusters")

@router.get("/{cluster_id}/export-log")
async def export_cluster_audit_events(
    cluster_id: str,
    cluster_repo: ClusterRepository = Depends(get_cluster_repo),
    ch_client = Depends(get_clickhouse_async_client),
    user: User = Depends(get_current_user)
):
    cluster = await cluster_repo.get_by_id(cluster_id)
    if not cluster:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND, detail="Cluster not found")

    if cluster.organization_id != user.organization_id:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=status.HTTP_403_FORBIDDEN, detail="Forbidden: cluster belongs to another organization")

    query = """
        SELECT timestamp, actor_id, action, resource, ip_address, status
        FROM cluster_audit_events
        WHERE cluster_id = {c_id:String}
        ORDER BY timestamp DESC
        LIMIT 1000
    """
    df = await ch_client.query_df(query, parameters={"c_id": cluster_id})
    if df.empty:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND, detail="No audit logs found for cluster")

    csv_buffer = io.StringIO()
    df.to_csv(csv_buffer, index=False)
    csv_buffer.seek(0)

    return StreamingResponse(
        iter([csv_buffer.getvalue()]),
        media_type="text/csv",
        headers={"Content-Disposition": f"attachment; filename=audit_{cluster_id}.csv"}
    )
